observations.accessibilityTree:
- link "Skip to main content":
  - /url: "#public-content"
- banner "One Talibon. One workspace.":
  - img "Talibon Municipal Hall, front entrance with Philippine flags"
  - link "ONE TALIBON home":
    - /url: "#home"
    - text: ONE TALIBON
  - link "Employee Login":
    - /url: /login
  - button "Open portal navigation"
  - paragraph: LGU INTRA-OFFICE PORTAL
  - heading "One Talibon. One workspace." [level=1]
  - paragraph: Municipal work, connected across offices. Manage documents, memoranda, schedules, projects, requests, and office coordination in one secure workspace.
  - link "Employee Login":
    - /url: /login
  - link "About the Portal":
    - /url: "#about-portal"
  - paragraph: Authorized municipal personnel only. Protected operational records remain inside authenticated access.
- main:
  - region "Portal Capabilities":
    - paragraph: Internal portal capabilities
    - heading "Portal Capabilities" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Core tools for moving municipal work between offices.
    - text: Available to authorized employees
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - heading "Inter-Office Transactions" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Route requests, endorsements, and actions between offices.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Documents & Memoranda" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Manage official documents, memoranda, records, and correspondence.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Employees & Offices" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Find office and personnel information in one workspace.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Calendar & Coordination" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Coordinate meetings, deadlines, activities, and schedules.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Notifications & Follow-Up" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Track work that needs review, action, or follow-up.
  - region "Built for municipal coordination.":
    - img "Municipality of Talibon seal"
    - paragraph: About the Portal
    - heading "Built for municipal coordination." [level=2]
    - paragraph: ONE TALIBON is the LGU’s shared intra-office workspace for coordinating official work, information, documents, schedules, and processes across municipal offices.
    - paragraph: Municipality of Talibon, Bohol
    - term: Access boundary
    - definition: Internal records, transactions, approvals, and employee information require authenticated access.
    - term: Municipality of Talibon
    - definition: Public contact details await municipal confirmation.
  - region "Secure municipal workspace.":
    - paragraph: Secure Access
    - heading "Secure municipal workspace." [level=2]
    - paragraph: Official work continues inside the authenticated LGU Intra-Office Portal.
    - list:
      - listitem: Authorized personnel only
      - listitem: Protected internal workspace
      - listitem: No live operational records on this page
    - link "Employee Login":
      - /url: /login
- contentinfo:
  - link "ONE TALIBON":
    - /url: "#home"
  - text: Municipality of Talibon, Bohol Talibon, Bohol, Philippines
  - navigation "Footer":
    - link "About the Portal":
      - /url: "#about-portal"
    - link "Internal Capabilities":
      - /url: "#capabilities"
    - link "Help / Support":
      - /url: "#support"
  - text: ONE TALIBON · Municipality of Talibon, Bohol Intra-Office Portal · Authorized municipal personnel
